upper_bound.quote:
The pair \((a,b)\) and the pair \(\bigl(\min(a,b),|a-b|\bigr)\) have the
same gcd:
\[
\gcd(a,b)=\gcd\bigl(\min(a,b),|a-b|\bigr)
\tag{3}
\]
(standard; details omitted).
upper_bound.witness: The write-up must prove for all nonnegative integers a,b that gcd(a,b)=gcd(min(a,b),|a-b|), including a=b and zero cases, and then justify preservation of the full exponent-vector gcd. The quoted passage explicitly omits the proof; later examples cover only selected boundary cases and still refer back to the unproved identity for the general case.
upper_bound.load_bearing: Identity (3) is the sole basis given for invariance of each G_p. Without an all-cases proof of that identity, the claimed choice-independence and formula for M are not established under the stated grading standard.

parsed.notes: The explicit formula for M is correct. Termination, the unique surviving nonunit, and the elementary valuation transformation are fully justified; only the general valuation-gcd invariance proof is omitted.
